versos.hebraico: וְעַתָּ֞ה כֹּֽה־אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ בֹּרַאֲךָ֣ יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְיֹצֶרְךָ֖ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אַל־תִּירָא֙ כִּ֣י גְאַלְתִּ֔יךָ קָרָ֥אתִי בְשִׁמְךָ֖ לִי־אָֽתָּה׃

controles.web: But now thus says Yahweh who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel: “Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine.
controles.kjv: But now thus saith the Lord that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.
controles.livre: Porém agora assim diz o SENHOR, o teu Criador, ó Jacó, e o teu Formador, ó Israel: Não temas, porque eu te resgatei; chamei a ti por teu nome; tu és meu.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־תַעֲבֹ֤ר בַּמַּ֨יִם֙ אִתְּךָ־אָ֔נִי וּבַנְּהָר֖וֹת לֹ֣א יִשְׁטְפ֑וּךָ כִּֽי־תֵלֵ֤ךְ בְּמוֹ־אֵשׁ֙ לֹ֣א תִכָּוֶ֔ה וְלֶהָבָ֖ה לֹ֥א תִבְעַר־בָּֽךְ׃

controles.web: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you.
controles.kjv: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
controles.livre: Quando passares pelas águas, estarei contigo; e ao passares pelos rios, eles não te submergirão; quando passares pelo fogo, não te queimarás, nem a chamas arderão em ti.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֗י אֲנִי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מוֹשִׁיעֶ֑ךָ נָתַ֤תִּי כָפְרְךָ֙ מִצְרַ֔יִם כּ֥וּשׁ וּסְבָ֖א תַּחְתֶּֽיךָ׃

controles.web: For I am Yahweh your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior. I have given Egypt as your ransom, Ethiopia and Seba in your place.
controles.kjv: For I am the Lord thy God, the Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour: I gave Egypt for thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee.
controles.livre: Porque eu sou o SENHOR teu Deus, o Santo de Israel, teu Salvador; dei ao Egito, a Cuxe, e a Seba como teu resgate, em teu lugar.

versos.hebraico: מֵאֲשֶׁ֨ר יָקַ֧רְתָּ בְעֵינַ֛י נִכְבַּ֖דְתָּ וַאֲנִ֣י אֲהַבְתִּ֑יךָ וְאֶתֵּ֤ן אָדָם֙ תַּחְתֶּ֔יךָ וּלְאֻמִּ֖ים תַּ֥חַת נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃

controles.web: Since you have been precious and honored in my sight, and I have loved you; therefore I will give people in your place, and nations instead of your life.
controles.kjv: Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee: therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life.
controles.livre: Visto que foste precioso em meus olhos, assim foste glorificado, e eu te amei; por isso dei homens em troca de ti, e povos em troca de tua alma.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תִּירָ֖א כִּ֣י אִתְּךָ־אָ֑נִי מִמִּזְרָח֙ אָבִ֣יא זַרְעֶ֔ךָ וּמִֽמַּעֲרָ֖ב אֲקַבְּצֶֽךָּ׃

controles.web: Don’t be afraid; for I am with you. I will bring your seed from the east, and gather you from the west.
controles.kjv: Fear not: for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west;
controles.livre: Não temas, pois estou contigo; eu trarei tua semente desde o oriente, e te ajuntarei desde o ocidente.

versos.hebraico: אֹמַ֤ר לַצָּפוֹן֙ תֵּ֔נִי וּלְתֵימָ֖ן אַל־תִּכְלָ֑אִי הָבִ֤יאִי בָנַי֙ מֵרָח֔וֹק וּבְנוֹתַ֖י מִקְצֵ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: I will tell the north, ‘Give them up!’ and tell the south, ‘Don’t hold them back! Bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth—
controles.kjv: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back: bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth;
controles.livre: Direi ao norte: Dá!, E ao sul: Não retenhas! Trazei meus filhos de longe, e minhas filhas desde os confins da terra;

versos.hebraico: כֹּ֚ל הַנִּקְרָ֣א בִשְׁמִ֔י וְלִכְבוֹדִ֖י בְּרָאתִ֑יו יְצַרְתִּ֖יו אַף־עֲשִׂיתִֽיו׃

controles.web: everyone who is called by my name, and whom I have created for my glory, whom I have formed, yes, whom I have made.’”
controles.kjv: Even every one that is called by my name: for I have created him for my glory, I have formed him; yea, I have made him.
controles.livre: Todos os chamados do meu nome, e os que criei para minha gloria; eu os formei; sim, eu os fiz.

versos.hebraico: הוֹצִ֥יא עַם־עִוֵּ֖ר וְעֵינַ֣יִם יֵ֑שׁ וְחֵרְשִׁ֖ים וְאָזְנַ֥יִם לָֽמוֹ׃

controles.web: Bring out the blind people who have eyes, and the deaf who have ears.
controles.kjv: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears.
controles.livre: Trazei ao povo cego, que tem olhos; e aos surdos, que tem ouvidos.

versos.hebraico: כָּֽל־הַגּוֹיִ֞ם נִקְבְּצ֣וּ יַחְדָּ֗ו וְיֵאָֽסְפוּ֙ לְאֻמִּ֔ים מִ֤י בָהֶם֙ יַגִּ֣יד זֹ֔את וְרִֽאשֹׁנ֖וֹת יַשְׁמִיעֻ֑נוּ יִתְּנ֤וּ עֵֽדֵיהֶם֙ וְיִצְדָּ֔קוּ וְיִשְׁמְע֖וּ וְיֹאמְר֥וּ אֱמֶֽת׃

controles.web: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the peoples be assembled. Who among them can declare this, and show us former things? Let them bring their witnesses, that they may be justified; or let them hear, and say, “That is true.”
controles.kjv: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the people be assembled: who among them can declare this, and shew us former things? let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified: or let them hear, and say, It is truth.
controles.livre: Todas as nações se reúnam, e os povos se ajuntem. Quem deles isto isto anuncia, e nos faz ouvir as coisas do passado? Mostrem suas testemunhas, para que se justifiquem, e se ouça, e se diga: É verdade.

versos.hebraico: אַתֶּ֤ם עֵדַי֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה וְעַבְדִּ֖י אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחָ֑רְתִּי לְמַ֣עַן תֵּ֠דְעוּ וְתַאֲמִ֨ינוּ לִ֤י וְתָבִ֨ינוּ֙ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֣י ה֔וּא לְפָנַי֙ לֹא־נ֣וֹצַר אֵ֔ל וְאַחֲרַ֖י לֹ֥א יִהְיֶֽה׃ס

controles.web: “You are my witnesses,” says Yahweh, “With my servant whom I have chosen; that you may know and believe me, and understand that I am he. Before me there was no God formed, neither will there be after me.
controles.kjv: Ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord, and my servant whom I have chosen: that ye may know and believe me, and understand that I am he: before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me.
controles.livre: Vós sois minhas testemunhas (diz o SENHOR); e meu servo, a quem escolhi; para que saibais, e creiais em mim, e entendais que eu sou o próprio, e que antes de mim nenhum Deus se formou, e depois de minha nenhum haverá.

versos.hebraico: אָנֹכִ֥י אָנֹכִ֖י יְהוָ֑ה וְאֵ֥ין מִבַּלְעָדַ֖י מוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃

controles.web: I myself am Yahweh; and besides me there is no savior.
controles.kjv: I, even I, am the Lord; and beside me there is no saviour.
controles.livre: Eu, eu sou o SENHOR; e fora de mim não há salvador.

versos.hebraico: אָנֹכִ֞י הִגַּ֤דְתִּי וְהוֹשַׁ֨עְתִּי֙ וְהִשְׁמַ֔עְתִּי וְאֵ֥ין בָּכֶ֖ם זָ֑ר וְאַתֶּ֥ם עֵדַ֛י נְאֻם־יְהוָ֖ה וַֽאֲנִי־אֵֽל׃

controles.web: I have declared, I have saved, and I have shown; and there was no strange god among you. Therefore you are my witnesses”, says Yahweh, “and I am God.
controles.kjv: I have declared, and have saved, and I have shewed, when there was no strange god among you: therefore ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord, that I am God.
controles.livre: Eu anunciei, eu salvei, e eu fiz ouvir, e deus estrangeiro não houve entre vós, e vós sois minhas testemunhas, (diz o SENHOR), que eu sou Deus.

versos.hebraico: גַּם־מִיּוֹם֙ אֲנִ֣י ה֔וּא וְאֵ֥ין מִיָּדִ֖י מַצִּ֑יל אֶפְעַ֖ל וּמִ֥י יְשִׁיבֶֽנָּה׃ס

controles.web: Yes, since the day was I am he; and there is no one who can deliver out of my hand. I will work, and who can hinder it?”
controles.kjv: Yea, before the day was I am he; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand: I will work, and who shall let it?
controles.livre: E desde antes de haver dia, eu o sou; e ninguém há que possa livrar das minhas mãos. Eu estou agindo, quem pode impedir?

versos.hebraico: כֹּֽה־אָמַ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה גֹּאַלְכֶ֖ם קְד֣וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְמַעַנְכֶ֞ם שִׁלַּ֣חְתִּי בָבֶ֗לָה וְהוֹרַדְתִּ֤י בָֽרִיחִים֙ כֻּלָּ֔ם וְכַשְׂדִּ֖ים בָּאֳנִיּ֥וֹת רִנָּתָֽם׃

controles.web: Thus says Yahweh, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: “For your sake, I have sent to Babylon, and I will bring all of them down as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships of their rejoicing.
controles.kjv: Thus saith the Lord, your redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and have brought down all their nobles, and the Chaldeans, whose cry is in the ships.
controles.livre: Assim diz o SENHOR o teu Redentor, o Santo de Israel: Por causa de vós eu enviei inimigos a Babilônia, e a todos eu os fiz descerem como fugitivos, inclusive os Caldeus, nos navios em que se orgulhavam.

versos.hebraico: אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה קְדֽוֹשְׁכֶ֑ם בּוֹרֵ֥א יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מַלְכְּכֶֽם׃ס

controles.web: I am Yahweh, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King.”
controles.kjv: I am the Lord, your Holy One, the creator of Israel, your King.
controles.livre: Eu sou o SENHOR, vosso Santo; o Criador de Israel, o vosso Rei.

versos.hebraico: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הַנּוֹתֵ֥ן בַּיָּ֖ם דָּ֑רֶךְ וּבְמַ֥יִם עַזִּ֖ים נְתִיבָֽה׃

controles.web: Thus says Yahweh, who makes a way in the sea,  and a path in the mighty waters;
controles.kjv: Thus saith the Lord, which maketh a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters;
controles.livre: Assim diz o SENHOR, aquele que preparou no mar um caminho, e nas águas impetuosas uma vereda;

versos.hebraico: הַמּוֹצִ֥יא רֶֽכֶב־וָס֖וּס חַ֣יִל וְעִזּ֑וּז יַחְדָּ֤ו יִשְׁכְּבוּ֙ בַּל־יָק֔וּמוּ דָּעֲכ֖וּ כַּפִּשְׁתָּ֥ה כָבֽוּ׃

controles.web: who brings out the chariot and horse, the army and the mighty man (they lie down together, they shall not rise; they are extinct, they are quenched like a wick):
controles.kjv: Which bringeth forth the chariot and horse, the army and the power; they shall lie down together, they shall not rise: they are extinct, they are quenched as tow.
controles.livre: Aquele que trouxe carruagens e cavalos, exército e forças; todos juntamente caíram, e não mais se levantaram; estão extintos, foram apagados como um pavio:

versos.hebraico: אַֽל־תִּזְכְּר֖וּ רִֽאשֹׁנ֑וֹת וְקַדְמֹנִיּ֖וֹת אַל־תִּתְבֹּנָֽנוּ׃

controles.web: “Don’t remember the former things, and don’t consider the things of old.
controles.kjv: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.
controles.livre: Não vos lembreis das coisas passadas, nem considereis as antigas;

versos.hebraico: הִנְנִ֨י עֹשֶׂ֤ה חֲדָשָׁה֙ עַתָּ֣ה תִצְמָ֔ח הֲל֖וֹא תֵֽדָע֑וּהָ אַ֣ף אָשִׂ֤ים בַּמִּדְבָּר֙ דֶּ֔רֶךְ בִּֽישִׁמ֖וֹן נְהָרֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
controles.kjv: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
controles.livre: Eis que farei uma coisa nova, agora surgirá; por acaso não a reconhecereis? Pois porei um caminho no deserto, e rios na terra vazia.

versos.hebraico: תְּכַבְּדֵ֨נִי֙ חַיַּ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה תַּנִּ֖ים וּבְנ֣וֹת יַֽעֲנָ֑ה כִּֽי־נָתַ֨תִּי בַמִּדְבָּ֜ר מַ֗יִם נְהָרוֹת֙ בִּֽישִׁימֹ֔ן לְהַשְׁק֖וֹת עַמִּ֥י בְחִירִֽי׃

controles.web: The animals of the field shall honor me, the jackals and the ostriches; because I give water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen,
controles.kjv: The beast of the field shall honour me, the dragons and the owls: because I give waters in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen.
controles.livre: Os animais do campo me honrarão; os chacais e os filhotes de avestruz; porque porei águas no deserto, rios na terra vazia, para dar de beber a meu povo, meu escolhido.

versos.hebraico: עַם־זוּ֙ יָצַ֣רְתִּי לִ֔י תְּהִלָּתִ֖י יְסַפֵּֽרוּ׃ס

controles.web: the people which I formed for myself, that they might declare my praise.
controles.kjv: This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.
controles.livre: Este povo formei para mim, eles declararão louvor a mim.

versos.hebraico: וְלֹא־אֹתִ֥י קָרָ֖אתָ יַֽעֲקֹ֑ב כִּֽי־יָגַ֥עְתָּ בִּ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: Yet you have not called on me, Jacob; but you have been weary of me, Israel.
controles.kjv: But thou hast not called upon me, O Jacob; but thou hast been weary of me, O Israel.
controles.livre: Porém tu não me invocaste, ó Jacó; pois te cansaste de mim, ó Israel.

versos.hebraico: לֹֽא־הֵבֵ֤יאתָ לִּי֙ שֵׂ֣ה עֹלֹתֶ֔יךָ וּזְבָחֶ֖יךָ לֹ֣א כִבַּדְתָּ֑נִי לֹ֤א הֶעֱבַדְתִּ֨יךָ֙ בְּמִנְחָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א הוֹגַעְתִּ֖יךָ בִּלְבוֹנָֽה׃

controles.web: You have not brought me of your sheep for burnt offerings; neither have you honored me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with offerings, nor wearied you with frankincense.
controles.kjv: Thou hast not brought me the small cattle of thy burnt offerings; neither hast thou honoured me with thy sacrifices. I have not caused thee to serve with an offering, nor wearied thee with incense.
controles.livre: Não me trouxeste o gado miúdo de tuas ofertas de queima, nem me honraste com teus sacrifícios; eu não vos oprimi com ofertas, nem te cansei com incenso.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־קָנִ֨יתָ לִּ֤י בַכֶּ֨סֶף֙ קָנֶ֔ה וְחֵ֥לֶב זְבָחֶ֖יךָ לֹ֣א הִרְוִיתָ֑נִי אַ֗ךְ הֶעֱבַדְתַּ֨נִי֙ בְּחַטֹּאותֶ֔יךָ הוֹגַעְתַּ֖נִי בַּעֲוֺנֹתֶֽיךָ׃ס

controles.web: You have bought me no sweet cane with money, nor have you filled me with the fat of your sacrifices; but you have burdened me with your sins. You have wearied me with your iniquities.
controles.kjv: Thou hast bought me no sweet cane with money, neither hast thou filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices: but thou hast made me to serve with thy sins, thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities.
controles.livre: Não me compraste com dinheiro cana aromática, nem me saciaste com a gordura de teus sacrifícios; mas me oprimiste com teus pecados, e me cansaste com tuas maldades.

versos.hebraico: אָנֹכִ֨י אָנֹכִ֥י ה֛וּא מֹחֶ֥ה פְשָׁעֶ֖יךָ לְמַעֲנִ֑י וְחַטֹּאתֶ֖יךָ לֹ֥א אֶזְכֹּֽר׃

controles.web: I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions for my own sake; and I will not remember your sins.
controles.kjv: I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.
controles.livre: Eu, eu sou o que anulo tuas transgressões por causa de mim; e te teus pecados eu não me lembro.

versos.hebraico: הַזְכִּירֵ֕נִי נִשָּׁפְטָ֖ה יָ֑חַד סַפֵּ֥ר אַתָּ֖ה לְמַ֥עַן תִּצְדָּֽק׃

controles.web: Put me in remembrance. Let us plead together. Declare your case, that you may be justified.
controles.kjv: Put me in remembrance: let us plead together: declare thou, that thou mayest be justified.
controles.livre: Faze-me lembrar, entremos em juízo juntos; mostra teus argumentos ,para que possas te justificar.

versos.hebraico: אָבִ֥יךָ הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן חָטָ֑א וּמְלִיצֶ֖יךָ פָּ֥שְׁעוּ בִֽי׃

controles.web: Your first father sinned, and your teachers have transgressed against me.
controles.kjv: Thy first father hath sinned, and thy teachers have transgressed against me.
controles.livre: Teu primeiro pai pecou; e teus intérpretes transgrediram contra mim.

versos.hebraico: וַאֲחַלֵּ֖ל שָׂ֣רֵי קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְאֶתְּנָ֤ה לַחֵ֨רֶם֙ יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְגִדּוּפִֽים׃ס

controles.web: Therefore I will profane the princes of the sanctuary; and I will make Jacob a curse, and Israel an insult.”
controles.kjv: Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary, and have given Jacob to the curse, and Israel to reproaches.
controles.livre: Por isso profanei os líderes do santuário, e entreguei Jacó à desgraça, e Israel à humilhação.
